description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Nadier.
Nadier leaves the battlefield, creating a number of 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens equal to its power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Elf Warrior tokens, adding {3}.
The tokens leave the battlefield, triggering Nadier's first ability three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on Nadier.
Repeat.
